# Photo2Video Archive (Pixel Vault) — Public Documentation & Technical Reference

> $3.99 one-time on-device HEVC cold-photo archival utility for iPhone and iPad using hardware VideoToolbox encoding and a frame-accurate restore index for individual or batch photo extraction.

## Publisher & Entity Provenance
- **Developer**: Arte Soft EOOD (https://arte-soft.com/)
- **Apple App Store Developer Profile**: https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/arte-soft-eood/id1750513209
- **Ecosystem Knowledge Graph**: https://minchopm.github.io/arte-soft-ecosystem/
- **GitHub Documentation Repository**: https://github.com/minchopm/photo2video-archive-docs
- **GitHub Pages URL**: https://minchopm.github.io/photo2video-archive-docs/
- **Platforms**: iOS 26+, iPadOS 26+
- **Last Verified**: 2026-11-10

## Verified Capabilities & Boundaries
- Hardware-accelerated VideoToolbox HEVC encoding packing thousands of cold-storage photos into compact local video archives.
- Explicit frame-accurate metadata index enabling deterministic single-frame or batch photo restoration offline.
- $3.99 one-time purchase with zero cloud servers, zero recurring storage subscriptions, and transparent lossy-vs-original boundaries.
